executive_summary.verdict: This account is pre-signal. $1,651.69 produced 2 reported purchases (blended CPA $825.85), but 61% of spend reports under Incremental attribution, which undercounts platform-attributable purchases. No creative can be declared a winner or loser yet. The real deliverables from this window are (a) a clean variable library, (b) two directional purchase signals worth isolating, and (c) three structural fixes that matter more than any creative decision.
structural_fixes_first: Re-export with funnel columns (link clicks, ATC, IC, purchases, revenue) so dimensions 1-2 can run — DONE 2026-07-09 (funnel columns landed; conversion-device export replaced the empty delivery pivot; dimension re-runs pending)
Unify attribution to 7DC/1DV across campaigns, keep Incremental as a separate holdout read, and reconcile against Shopify/LittleData server-side purchase counts
Cap Advantage+ text variants; 15-29 copy variants per ad on sub-$400 spend destroys copy isolation
